sentences.text:
Ved Ram Verma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 August, 2025
Author: Raj Beer Singh

Bench: Raj Beer Singh
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Case :- Application U/S 528 Bnss No. - 27805 of 2025

Applicant :- Ved Ram Verma
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another

Counsel for Applicant :- Harish Chandra,Ram Chandra Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Raj Beer Singh,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. This application under Section 528 BNSS has been preferred for quashing of the non-bailable warrant order dated 21.10.2021, passed in Criminal Case No. 3449 of 2012 (State v. Sudha Devi and others), arising out of Case Crime No. 52 of 2010, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 409, 504 of IPC, Police Station- Eka, District- Firozabad.

entities.text: Criminal Case No. 3449 of 2012 (State v. Sudha Devi and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant in the aforesaid case applicant was on bail and he was regularly appearing before the trial court but during COVID-19 pandemic, applicant has fallen ill.
It was submitted that applicant could not appear before the trial court, due to which,
non -bailable warrants have been issued against him.

It is further submitted that applicant is a 71 Ved Ram Verma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/8052586/
1 year old person.

entities.text: 71 Ved Ram Verma vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
It is next submitted that the prayer made above is not being pressed and the applicant would appear before the trial court and a direction may be made to the trial court to decide the bail application of applicant expeditiously and till then, protection may be granted to him.
4.

In view of aforesaid, it is directed that in case, applicant appears/ surrenders before the court concerned within a period of three weeks from today and applies for bail, his bail application shall be considered and decided expeditiously, in accordance with settled law.
For a period of three weeks from today or till the applicant surrenders before the court below, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant in the aforesaid case.
5. With the aforesaid observations, the application under Section 528 BNSS is disposed of.
